messages:
Maria H: Hey team — I pushed the followups and split the big change into two smaller PRs to make the rollback easier. PTAL when you have a minute. I ran unit tests locally but ran into a merge conflict with the canary branch when trying to merge the first PR. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1289
Aj Patel: thanks, looking. can you paste the conflict snippet? might be the api contract change from yesterday.
Maria H: sure — conflict was in server/pkg/route/handler.go, small signature tweak. gist: ```diff
- func Serve(ctx, req)
+ func Serve(ctx, req, meta)
```
I reverted the signature in the smaller PR and left the feature in the follow-up PR to avoid breaking canary.
Sam B: quick Q — is the smaller PR safe to merge without a canary? if it's just a signature revert, should be fine for a fast merge + smoke.
Kevin L: depends on timing. we have a canary rollout scheduled in ~45m. if we merge now it might land before canary snaps and complicate rollbacks. can we gate with a short freeze window?
Maria H: I can hold merge until after the canary snapshot if folks prefer. the follow-up PR (feature) is blocked on some perf tests anyway.
Aj Patel: I'll take the smaller PR now, run the smoke suite in CI. if green, i'll queue it but won't merge until the canary snapshot completes. pls add me as reviewer so i can approve quickly.
Maria H: added you. thanks!
deploy-bot: Canary snapshot scheduled: 2142001400 (in ~16m). Config: canary=stable-2026-03-17-03, snapshot=true
Sam B: sounds good — if Aj approves i can do a manual quick validation on staging after the snapshot. :thumbsup:
Kevin L: thanks for splitting — much easier to reason about rollback.
Maria H: thanks all — ping me here if you'd like me to hold the merge until you say go.
